material_findings.location: DESIGN.md round2 exact boundary freeze, final precedence paragraph
material_findings.problem: Startup rejects invalid configured TTL is unsupported and false for zero/negative TTL at the pinned source. parse_time_duration_secs parses i64 and directly creates Duration; AuthRestState::new stores the resulting refresh_family_absolute_ttl without positivity checking. Current accepted Auth source rejects nonpositive TTL at request time with finite Unavailable after credential/shape validation.
material_findings.impact: Exact proposed tests/admission could rely on nonexistent startup prerequisites, or broaden shared configuration behavior without explicit scope. This is design/baseline fidelity, not an observed authorization allow.
material_findings.remedy: Remove startup-rejection assertion and preserve accepted per-owner finite503 behavior, documenting configuration validation as separate work; alternatively explicitly admit a narrow startup validation change and independent tests without changing unrelated duration parsing.
